ui.welcome:
Hi! Forward me Telegram posts (text, photos, captions or albums). I'll score them, and for good ones I'll draft an original English X post and prepare the images.

Use /menu for tools.
ui.unauthorized: Sorry, you are not allowed to use this bot.
ui.review_header: ⚠️ Needs review: task {task_id}. ⛔ = blocking (regenerate or reject), 🔎 = check before approving:
ui.ai_label: AI-generated images are marked 🤖; consider labeling them when posting.
ui.draft_text_follows: The post text follows in the next message (tap to copy).
ui.approved: ✅ Approved task {task_id}. Copy the text below and attach the images above when posting to X.
ui.media_unavailable: 🖼 Images unavailable right now ({items}); the text draft is complete. See the admin UI or regenerate.
ui.language_settings: Choose the language for the bot, admin UI and new publishing bundles. Existing drafts keep their language; regenerate to use the new language.
ui.generic_failure: The operation failed. Please retry or check the task timeline.
ui.task_failure: Processing failed. Please retry or check the admin timeline.
ui.policy_sensitive: Sensitive content; needs a human decision.
ui.policy_unrelated: Image looks unrelated to the post.
ui.policy_owned: Owned or authorized media; quality and language OK.
ui.policy_enhance: Owned visual with low quality; quality pass only.
ui.policy_localize: Recreate informational text in the selected language; preserve facts and brand names.
ui.policy_recreate: Create an original information card or illustration from the source facts.
ui.policy_news_card: Unlicensed real-person/news photo; replace with a clearly non-documentary information card.
ui.policy_unknown: Rights or content unclear; needs review.
ui.qc_rejected: QC model did not pass the image.
ui.qc_unavailable: QC unavailable; the image requires review.
ui.media_download: Media download failed; continuing with text only.
ui.media_deleted: Could not download from Telegram (deleted or unavailable).
ui.media_unused: Not analyzed: Jev judged the media not useful.
ui.media_unreadable: File is not a readable image.
ui.media_duplicate: Image #{idx} was already forwarded in task {task_id} ({status}).
ui.storage_budget: R2 storage budget reached; image unavailable.
ui.jev_unconfigured: Jev not configured; main LLM decides.
ui.jev_no_text: No usable text for Jev; vision + LLM decide.
ui.jev_uncertain: Jev uncertain about value; main LLM evaluation decides.
ui.jev_media: Media judged not useful (p={value}); not analyzed.
ui.guard_translation: Model reports the post merely restates/translates the source.
ui.guard_value: No added value described beyond the source.
ui.guard_similarity: Too close to the source text (similarity {value}).
ui.guard_numbers: Numbers not found in source or approved facts (possible fabrication): {items}
ui.guard_llm_numbers: Numbers backed only by LLM-extracted facts, not the source text: {items}
ui.guard_language: Output contains explanatory text in the wrong language.
ui.clean_failed: Core-content extraction unavailable; deterministic cleaning used.
ui.blocking: Draft has blocking problems; regenerate or reject it.
ui.cannot_approve: Only ready or reviewed drafts can be approved (currently {status}).
ui.ops_busy: Saved; queue is busy, the sweeper will pick it up shortly.
ui.connection_failed: Connection failed; check the server logs.
ui.admin_No tasks yet. Forward something to: No tasks yet. Forward something to the bot.
ui.admin_Saved to MySQL and applied immedia: Saved to MySQL and applied immediately (clients are rebuilt). API keys are environment-only and cannot be edited here. "env" means the value comes from
ui.admin_To return a key to its env value,: To return a key to its env value, reset it:
ui.qc_images_pair: The first image is the SOURCE reference, the second is the CANDIDATE.
ui.qc_candidate: The attached image is the CANDIDATE.
ui.admin_Locale mismatch: This saved task uses a different language. Regenerate to apply the current language.
ui.image_tools_title: Image Tools — selections are remembered for your next task.
ui.image_tools_queued: Image processing queued; the text draft stays unchanged.
ui.image_tools_not_ready: This task is busy or has no draft yet.
ui.image_tools_owner: This task belongs to another operator or chat.
ui.image_rights_required: Keeping or enhancing this source requires confirmed editing rights.
ui.image_facts_unavailable: No verified fact packet is available; generated images need review.
ui.image_rerun_failed: Image processing failed. The text draft is unchanged.
ui.image_source_required: This action needs a source image; choose Generate or Information card for text-only tasks.
ui.cleanup_rights_required: Targeted removal needs confirmed editing rights; no source editing was performed.
ui.cleanup_scope_required: No safe, explicitly selected promotion region is available; copyright/author/unknown marks must stay.
ui.cleanup_no_promotion: No promotion overlay detected; original image kept unchanged.
ui.cleanup_authorized: Authorized local promotion cleanup; all original content outside selected regions is preserved.
ui.cleanup_pixel_failure: The result changed pixels or dimensions outside the permitted region.
ui.media_stage_image2: Image2 did not produce a valid processed image.
ui.media_stage_missing_asset: No final asset is attached to this image.
ui.media_stage_fetch: The final image could not be read from R2 or is not a valid image.
ui.media_stage_send: Telegram did not confirm a photo attachment for this image.
ui.cleanup_regions_help: Only identified promotion regions can be selected. An empty selection means all clearly identified safe promotion regions; protected attribution is never removable.
ui.cleanup_task_required: Open Image Tools from a task to select specific regions.
ui.btn_confirm_edit_rights: ✅ I confirm I have editing rights for this image (#{idx})
ui.edit_auth_queued: Editing rights confirmed for this image only. Its image pipeline is queued; the X draft stays unchanged.
ui.edit_auth_stale: This confirmation is no longer available. Open the latest review card.
ui.error_invalid_image: The service returned unreadable image data.
ui.error_rejected: The service rejected or could not complete the request.
ui.cleanup_region_uncertain: The promotion is identified, but its edit boundary/background is uncertain. Refine the region or explicitly allow an original information-card fallback.
ui.cleanup_content_occluded: The promotion covers meaningful source content; minimal editing cannot invent hidden text/UI. An original information-card fallback needs explicit permission.
ui.cleanup_card_fallback: Using an explicitly permitted original information card because local promotion cleanup is unsafe; this does not modify the source.
ui.image_option_info_card_fallback: Allow an original information card if local cleanup is unsafe
ui.draft_in_image_caption: The X draft is included with the image(s), ready to copy.
ui.guard_promotion: The draft contains identified channel promotion; remove it.
ui.image_tools_creation_priority: The selected action creates an original image; checked preferences apply to the new design.
ui.image_tools_auto_bundle_help: Enabled: forwards within 3 seconds form one task. Recreate source images as original visuals; text-only tasks receive an information card. Images and draft arrive together, without source-edit confirmation. Manual reruns use the selected action.
ui.auto_bundle_evaluate: Automatic bundle requested; continuing to factual evaluation with Jev warnings retained.
ui.auto_bundle_image_limit: Available source material was combined; this X bundle contains up to {count} original visuals, so additional source images are not separately output.
